verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a Linux desktop distribution, for example batch file actions or multi-item CLI commands. The evidence never documents an Omarchy bulk-operation feature. A theme restyling the whole system at once is an adjacent behavior, not bulk operations over many items. The bundled agent harnesses (OpenCode, Claude Code) and the omarchy CLI are third-party tools or building blocks, so they earn no credit here.
